exposure: Primiparous women with intact muscles following elective C-section
Primiparous women with bilaterally intact muscles who had delivered via C-section
outcome: Accuracy and reliability of measuring PVM cross-sectional area (CSA) using MRI
cohort: 38 primiparous women: 11 with unilateral PVM tears, 7 with intact muscles following elective C-section, and 20 with bilaterally intact muscles who had delivered via C-section
finding: MRI can be used to reliably and accurately measure the maximum anatomic cross-sectional area of the pubovisceral muscle belly, minimizing the inclusion of adjacent muscles.
mod_finding: This study focuses on MRI measurements of the pubovisceral muscle in women following C-section delivery, not specifically on mode of delivery.
